1.label: palm
1.desc: All fingers extended and spread apart

2.label: fist
2.desc: All fingers folded into the palm

3.label: thumb up
3.desc: Thumb extended upward, other fingers folded

4.label: peace
4.desc: Index and middle fingers extended forming a 'V'

5.label: ok
5.desc: Thumb and index finger form a circle, other fingers extended

6.label: index up
6.desc: Index finger extended upward, others folded

7.label: pinch
7.desc: Thumb and index finger close together as if pinching

8.label: rock
8.desc: Index and pinky fingers extended, others folded

9.label: call
9.desc: Thumb and pinky extended outward, others folded

10.label: gun sign
10.desc: Thumb and index finger extended like a gun shape

11.label: L sign
11.desc: Thumb and index finger extended forming an 'L' shape

12.label: C sign
12.desc: Fingers curved to form a 'C' shape
